comments.text: Vienna is a dead city because the way it is administrated. There are so many rules, regulations and laws, half of the city works for the city administration and it's more or less run in a half communistic way. The art is dominated by the ruling party f.e., you cannot do anything without their permission... I lived here all my life but as safe and beautiful it looks living here is like wanting nothing and with no desire for living free on your terms...not possible. You cannot breathe when wanting to go your own way here...
